mathematical_anchors.name: NEON_Vectorized_DefaultBidiResult_Level_0xFE_and_Identity_Maps
mathematical_anchors.formula: levels[i] = 0xFE (254 = UBIDI_DEFAULT_LTR), visual_map[i] = i, logical_map[i] = i for i in 0..N-1
mathematical_anchors.proof: When char_count > 7 and output buffers do not alias (checked at 0x01c52c..0x01c580), 0x01c584..0x01c5d8 loads `q0 = {0, 1, 2, 3}` from `.rodata` `0x00d9e0` (`ldr q0, [x12, #0x9e0]`), sets `v1.8b = 0xFE` (`movi v1.8b, #0xfe`), `v2.4s = 4`, `v3.4s = 8`, and loops in 8-element steps storing 8 bytes of `0xFE` to `levels` (`stur d4, [x12, #-4]`) and two `uint32x4_t` vectors `{i..i+3}`, `{i+4..i+7}` to `visual_map` and `logical_map` (`stp q0, q5, ...`), followed by the scalar tail at 0x01c5e4..0x01c600.

mathematical_anchors.name: BoundaryAnalyst_Unicode_CJK_and_PIC_JumpTable_Classifier
mathematical_anchors.formula: Classifies UTF-32 codepoints into 6 line-breaking classes {0..5} via CJK range shifts, bitmasks (0x00080440, 0x00000220, 0x46000901, 0x00010403, 0x00008200), and .rodata 0x00d9fc[175] jump table
mathematical_anchors.proof: At 0x02b268..0x02b29c, constants w9=-0x4e00, w10=-0x3400, w11=-0x3040, w12=-0x2013, w14=0x00080440, w15=0x00000220, w17=-0xff01, w0=-0x3001, w1=0xff5e, w2=0x00010403, w3=0x00008200, w4=0x46000901 are loaded. Codepoints in Plane 2 (`(cp & 0xffff0000) == 0x20000`), Hiragana/Katakana (`(cp - 0x3040) < 0xc0`), CJK Unified (`((cp - 0x4e00) >> 9) < 0x29`), and CJK Ext-A (`((cp - 0x3400) >> 6) < 0x67`) receive class 2. Codepoints in U+0009..U+00B7 index into `.rodata` `0x00d9fc` (`adr x6, #0x2b2ac; ldrb w7, [x16, x5]; add x6, x6, x7, lsl #2; br x6`).

mathematical_anchors.name: LayoutMeasurer_LinePitch_and_Element_Vertical_Alignment
mathematical_anchors.formula: CalcElementY: align<2 -> -(line_asc + elem_asc); align in {6,7} -> line_desc - elem_desc; align==3 -> (line_desc + ((line_asc + line_desc) - (elem_desc - elem_asc))*(-0.5f)) - elem_desc
mathematical_anchors.proof: At 0x02cb94..0x02cbf4, `and w8, w0, #0xff` dispatches on `CharacterVerticalAlignment`: `w8 < 2` executes `fadd s0, s0, s2; fneg s4, s0` (`0x02cbb8..0x02cbbc`); `w8 - 6 < 2` executes `fsub s4, s1, s3` (`0x02cbac`); `w8 == 3` (`kCenter`) executes `fsub s2, s3, s2; fadd s0, s0, s1; fsub s0, s0, s2; fmov s2, #-0.5; fmul s0, s0, s2; fadd s0, s1, s0; fsub s4, s0, s3` (`0x02cbd4..0x02cbec`).

mathematical_anchors.name: UTF8_to_UTF32_Bitfield_Accumulator_and_0x75_Reserve_Ratio
